snippet.title: Market Simulator: Miami Beach Available on Steam & Epic Games
snippet.description:
🌴 Build your supermarket empire in the heart of Miami Beach!

Start with nothing but a tent and turn your small business into a thriving retail empire. Drive to wholesalers, stock shelves, manage employees, survive the streets, and grow your market across Miami Beach.

🚀 Wishlist now on Steam!
📅 Launching June 19, 2026

Every wishlist helps us reach more players and continue improving the game. Thank you for your support! #marketsimulator #miamibeach #wishlistnow #steamwishlist #steamgame #indiegame
